rule_text.name: 702.194a
rule_text.rule: Bleed is a static ability that functions while the card with bleed is on the stack. “Bleed (cost)” means “You may pay (cost) rather than pay this spell's mana cost as you cast this spell if an opponent lost life this turn.”

rule_text.name: 702.194b
rule_text.rule: Bleed only cares if an opponent lost life. If those opponents gained the life back, you can still cast a spell for its bleed cost. If your opponents have only lost glory counters and not life, you can't cast a spell for its bleed cost.
